title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 055
review_goal: Differentiate cylinder, desk lamp, and diamond variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Simple cylinder shape with an oval top and two straight side walls
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain three dimensional cylinder with a closed side wall.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the cut cylinder when the center should look open like an H shaped gap.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one closed cylinder body with an oval top and smooth sides.

items.depicts_observation: Open cylinder ring with an oval top and one centered h shaped cut
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a hollow cylinder form with a clear center opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the closed cylinder when the side wall should stay solid.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the cylinder wall into an h like cut beneath the oval top.

items.depicts_observation: Table lamp with a trapezoid shade above a short stem and one small pull dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple table lamp with a wide shade and tiny pull dot.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the angled desk lamp when the arm and pointed shade should lean to one side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a straight lamp stem under one trapezoid shade and one hanging dot.

items.depicts_observation: Angled desk lamp with a bent arm above a pointed shade and round base joint
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an adjustable desk lamp leaning forward on a bent arm.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straight table lamp when the shade and stem should stay upright.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot bends the arm and tilts the pointed lamp shade toward one side.

items.depicts_observation: Tall diamond outline with four long sides and pointed top and bottom
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple diamond outline without internal gemstone facets.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the cut gemstone when flat top edges and facet lines should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a plain tall rhombus with no internal lines or flat top.
